_readme: Fixed question set for @betanyc/nyc-budget-mcp, written 2026-11-18 before scoring (#345).
Each answer was worked out from the repo's own committed files (the path in `from`), never from the server's index, then the questions were run.
A question passes when every `contains` string is in the answer text and no `not_contains` string is. `tables: true` needs the PDF tables (pretest builds them).
Run: npm run eval (after npm test's pretest, or with --tables <pdf-tables.db>). Add --record to save the run in eval/runs/.
It tests the answers of the named tools: each question names its tool and arguments. It does not test whether a model picks the right tool.
A check changed after a run says so, with the date and why, in the question's `note`.
